profile.headline: Software Engineer at Northrop Grumman
profile.summary:
Highly motivated individual who enjoys an environment that will challenge me to problem solve and learn.
Very detail-oriented, a benefit in a development environment, whether application- or web-based.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Assisting various teams while waiting for applicable software development to begin for me. Currently assisting in project management by gather requirements and teams together for a Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) team to create models of the integrations between different systems and pieces of software.

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description: In the pursuit of continuous development and continuous integration, support teams of software developers across the nation through the building and maintaining virtual servers and desktops, both a mixture of Windows and Linux operating systems, by using tools such as VMware vCenter and Horizon to enable software development supporting various programs and products.

positions.title: Systems Engineer and Web Developer
positions.description:
- Maintaining the internal web environment and assisting with maintaining and upgrading the current network assets.
-Administrate Citrix XenApp environment
-Support various file and printer servers as well as domain controller on both Windows Server 2008 R2 and Windows Server 2012 R2

positions.title: Asset Administrator/Web Developer
positions.description:
-Implemented first computer hardware and software management system in the company's history. 

-Took over the Sprint and Verizon cellular account management, improving relations with our mobile account managing company, combining multiple accounts into a single Sprint and single Verizon account to streamline management and billing. 

-Worked with an outside company to implement a managed print services program in order to: reduce strain on the IT department having to support a fleet of printers; create a more standard model of machines to be supported; attempt to reduce printing costs by reducing printer footprint, increasing copier/MFP footprint where needed, and billing print costs back to departments to increase printing visibility.

-Worked with Sprint to migrate over 900 Nextel devices across 12 nationwide offices: involving activating devices, creating and disseminating instructions on how to install time keeping applications that link back to Bergelectric's payroll system, and printing over 2,000 ID cards. 

-Began assisting the IT and Marketing directors by creating a website for a newly developed joint venture partnership between Bergelectric and Helix Electric, www.berg-helix.com; branding two careers search pages, one for the Bergelectric website and one for the Berg-Helix website; and modernizing the html coding of the Bergelectric website. Currently still works in progress.

positions.title: Communications Chief
positions.description:
-Planned communication training curriculum for 13 week long training of teams of Marines, known as Transition Teams, who's primary function was to then train and advise foreign military and law enforcement. This training to was instruct Marines who had little to know communication background on the functionality of operating radio communication devices in small groups when no other communications support is provided. 

-Developed training courses on newly developed software, allowing radios to be used to send encrypted email messages.

positions.title: Sergeant
positions.description:
-Managed groups of upward of 50 junior Marines
-Responsible for balancing annual training schedules with respect to mission critical training on primary military specialties in order for deployment preparation.

educations.schoolName: Keller Graduate School of Management of DeVry University

educations.degreeName: Bachelors of Science in Computer Information Systems
